goals.title: Critical Taylor news is live within 1 hour, with social and a push notification
goals.target: 90% of critical stories live on the site in 60 minutes or less from the first public report, with a social post and a push sent (push stays under the notification governor). A written rule defines "critical".
goals.now: No breaking lane and no definition of "critical" exist. Through the Vault the path is 24 to 48 hours; through the live feed it is up to 4 hours plus a 15-minute cache. The growth strategy found 0 of 27 time-sensitive events reached social within 2 hours.
goals.measure: Record five timestamps for every story: first public, detected, on site, social, push. Report median and 90th percentile each week, and every critical story that missed 60 minutes.

goals.title: We never miss a piece of Taylor news
goals.target: Recall of 98% or higher within 48 hours, and 100% within 1 hour for critical stories, against a reference list. Each miss is named and traced to a source gap.
goals.now: Recall is not measured and the old recall check was retired on Sep 10. The growth strategy found 12 of 27 events on the site within 48 hours.
goals.measure: Weekly zero-LLM diff of our stories against Google News, top fan posts and official channels. Misses file intake issues automatically.

goals.title: The largest "clowning" database in the world
goals.target: Fan theories ingested every day, tagged by Easter egg, status and clowning level. Growth of 50 or more live fan theories a week by week 6.
goals.now: The pipeline exists but the Reddit crawl ships switched off, so the theory miner and promoter had nothing to mine and their green runs ingested nothing. About 74 hand-authored theory records exist in the seed.
goals.measure: Weekly counts of candidates, live fan theories, promoted theories and published records, plus the share with a clowning tag.

goals.title: No content is ever missing a picture or video
goals.target: Zero new items without media. Anything with no media is blocked at merge. Existing offenders trend to zero within 6 weeks.
goals.now: 775 of 784 moments declare a photos list, but nothing blocks an empty list or a photoless new item. The "live feed hides items with no image" claim could not be confirmed in code.
goals.measure: check-media.mjs on every PR, plus a weekly percentage of moments and live items with media and a list of exceptions.

goals.title: New site content gets priority on our social
goals.target: At least half of daily posts cite a moment shipped in the last 7 days, and every critical story gets a post. The poster sends one item per platform per day, so the target is priority, not every item.
goals.now: Social merged 0 PRs in the week of Oct 12 and followers were X 0, Instagram 4, Facebook 10 on Oct 4. Nothing feeds Tree a list of what just shipped.
goals.measure: Join shipped moment IDs to queue and posted items. Report the share of posts citing new content and the time from ship to post.

goals.title: Copy is high quality and always in a swifty voice
goals.target: Every item shows love for Taylor, an opinion, and clowning where it fits. Weekly model score mean at 4.0 or higher, and Joey rates a weekly sample of 10.
goals.now: The CI voice check only catches surname overuse and six AI-sounding phrases. There is no exemplar set, no critique loop and no score.
goals.measure: A separate critic pass scores love, insight, opinion, clowning fit and AI tells against owner-picked exemplars. Report the weekly mean next to Joey's ratings.

goals.title: We post in the most important Reddit and Facebook conversations
goals.target: A daily short list of the highest-value threads, with about 20 comments a week posted at a human pace.
goals.now: Reddit scans and reply drafts reach Discord as cards and the owner posts by hand. Facebook reach is the owner's weekly export, because a Facebook crawler was ruled out on Aug 11.
goals.measure: Threads found, cards posted or skipped, and comments posted per week, by platform and sub.

goals.title: Our Reddit comments get upvotes
goals.target: Median score of at least 3 on posted comments, rising each month.
goals.now: We do badly and nothing is recorded. No script reads scores on our comments.
goals.measure: A daily job reads the brand account's public comment feed through a residential relay, with no API key, and records score at 1 hour, 24 hours and 7 days.

goals.title: Our Reddit and Facebook comments get replies
goals.target: At least 25% of comments get a reply, shown by platform.
goals.now: Reddit replies to us arrive through Gmail and Page comments through the reply notifier, but neither feeds a dashboard. Facebook group replies are not captured.
goals.measure: Count replies per posted comment from the same outcomes job, plus Page reply counts from the notifier.

goals.title: New fan merch is found and posted automatically
goals.target: At least 5 new fan-made items a week appear in the app with no hand-editing.
goals.now: Fan-made candidates are filed daily with no LLM. The curation step into the seed is not clearly scheduled. The 38 Awin PRs are coverage-map updates, not items in the app.
goals.measure: Count distinct new merch items published per week, by source.

goals.title: At least 3 new affiliate pieces per week that match what Taylor wears
goals.target: 3 or more new items a week with a live affiliate link, each matched to a specific photo of Taylor.
goals.now: Three blockers: the affiliate tags are unset in Vercel, the step that writes matched products onto moments is not built, and the matcher runs only by hand. Counsel cleared the layer on Aug 30.
goals.measure: Items with a valid affiliate link and a linked photo, added per week.

producers.d: Opus, up to 6 lanes, branch vault/
Owner reaction signed into queue file

findings.title: The only app-content producer stops when the Claude weekly limit is hit
findings.one: The last three scheduled Vault Runs failed on the weekly limit; 7 of 33 runs failed in 30 days.
ev: Scheduled Vault Runs on Oct 12, 13 and 14 failed with "You've hit your weekly limit" (reset Oct 14, 11pm UTC). Routine news triage hit the same limit.
A manual run after the reset succeeded and opened #5798, so the pipeline works when it has budget.
About 27 routine workflows share one CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, so chat, ops and desk routines spend the same weekly budget as content. No alert names the weekly limit.
Issue #5799 blames a checkout flake across 14 workflows. The log line it quotes is script text echoed in the log, not the cause.
findings.fix: Give content producers their own credential or reserved budget with a dollar cap per run. Add a named weekly-limit alert that pauses non-content routines until reset. Flow: LLM budget (new), Vault Run. Goals 1 to 4, 6.

findings.title: Latency is built into the design, so a 1-hour goal is impossible today
findings.one: News reaches the site in 24 to 48 hours through the Vault, or up to 4 hours through the live feed.
ev: Vault path: 4-hour poll, daily triage at 15:40, daily Vault Run at 16:07, then CI and auto-merge. Live-feed path: 4-hour poll, extract, 15-minute cache.
The growth strategy found 0 of 27 time-sensitive events reached social within 2 hours and 12 of 27 reached the site within 48 hours.
Nothing defines "critical", and no timestamps record when a story was public versus live.
findings.fix: Build a separate breaking lane: 10-minute poll of primary sources, a classifier, a live gate, a live card, push and social fan-out. Flow: Breaking poll, Critical classifier, Live gate, Live card + push. Goals 1, 2, 5.

findings.title: Output is capped by design, and uneven on top of that
findings.one: 24 PRs and 2,561 added lines in 30 days, median 100 lines; even a fully funded run adds about 3 moments a day.
ev: Content Shift is capped at 3 items a run and Photo Enrichment at 10 pages. One session runs six lanes in turn with a 200-turn limit.
Weekly lines added: 859, 575, 586, 509, then 32 in the partial latest week. Oct 9 and Oct 11 ran only Photo Enrichment (+18 and +5 lines).
Content landed on 21 of 31 days. Lane-level causes are inferred from PR titles and size, not run logs.
findings.fix: Run one job per lane, write a yield record into each PR body, and raise caps lane by lane once voice and media gates exist. Flow: Vault Run, CI build gate. Goals 3, 4, 6.

findings.title: The theory engine is switched off
findings.one: The crawl ships off, so the miner and promoter ran green on nothing.
ev: COMMUNITY_CRAWL_ENABLED defaults to false (docs/community/README.md). The theory miner is a clean no-op while it is off.
Promotion needs 3 mentions and weaving needs 8, tuned for caution rather than for the largest database.
About 74 hand-authored theory records are the whole database today.
findings.fix: Owner flips the switch with a budget of 20, add the Facebook export and mainstream roundups as sources, lower promotion to 2 mentions with a heat score. Flow: Theory crawl, Clowning database. Goal 3.

findings.title: Several feeders fail often, but the 30-day number overstates it
findings.one: Appearance discovery 21% reliable and Awin sync 24% over 30 days; both were patched on Oct 6.
ev: appearance-discovery: 13 ok, 49 failed of 62 runs, and it failed again on Oct 15 with channel failures.
merch-awin-sync: 8 ok, 25 failed, 29 cancelled. merch-official-sync: 37 ok, 25 failed. routine-tree-weekly-plan: 5 of 8 failed, with a turn-limit error (81 of 80 turns) on Oct 9.
The dashboard should show the last 7 days next to the 30-day figure. Failure causes were collected for only about 22 runs.
findings.fix: Pull the logs for appearance-discovery and tree-weekly-plan first. Show 7-day and 30-day reliability. Flow: Detectors, Merch syncs, Tree. Goals 10, 11.

findings.title: The owner is on the critical path four times
findings.one: Social approval, every Reddit and Facebook reply, the weekly Facebook export and device checks all wait on Joey.
ev: Social posts needed the owner reaction in #longlive-tree; Tree can now approve his own IG and X drafts (#5479), a change on the Hermes side that was not confirmed in this repo.
Reddit and Facebook comments are posted by hand, about 10 to 15 minutes a day, by design.
The Facebook export runs from the owner's PC on Sunday night. Device checks HA #100 and #101 block the store build.
findings.fix: Decide what is automatic (confirmed critical stories) and what stays human (comments). Flow: Approval, Owner posts. Goals 1, 5, 7.

findings.title: A test failure storm buries real failures, but is not blocking content
findings.one: 154 social state PRs are open and cause 79% of CI failures.
ev: 172 social-poster state PRs were opened in 30 days and 154 are still open. 1,127 of 1,422 CI failures are on their branches.
The failing step is build-full. The pipeline research traced it to draft-happy-path.test.ts, which reads live social state and trips the photo-reuse rule. I have not read the test myself.
Content PRs still merge: 203 of 207, median 14 minutes. That contradicts the claim in #5573 that this blocks all content auto-merge.
Failures get re-filed as watchdog alerts and 21 are open.
findings.fix: Make the test hermetic with fixture state and skip the full build for ledger-only PRs, then close the stuck PRs. Flow: Queue PR + CI. Goal 5.

findings.title: Gates that rot: voice and media are not enforced
findings.one: The CI voice check catches surname overuse and six AI phrases; nothing checks media or quality.
ev: scripts/check-voice.mjs documents the lesson that a cadence is not a gate, yet media completeness and voice quality rely on cadence.
No exemplar corpus, critic pass or score exists. The lane charters ask for voice but nothing measures it.
findings.fix: Add check-media.mjs as a CI gate with a ratcheting exception list, and a voice critic with owner-picked exemplars. Flow: CI build gate, Voice critic. Goals 4, 6.

findings.title: Social output dropped to zero this week
findings.one: No social PRs merged in the week of Oct 12; the poster failed on its last run.
ev: Social PRs merged per week: 24, 12, 20, 10, then 0.
social-poster: 113 failed of 522 runs. One Instagram post fails permanently and an X post returns 403, so each run exits non-zero and re-files an alert.
Tree is moving from Actions routines to a Hermes loop, so part of the zero may be the handover. The Hermes side was not checked.
findings.fix: Move the two failing items to social/failed so the poster exits clean, then confirm in a Hermes session that Tree is drafting. Flow: Social poster, Tree. Goal 5.

findings.title: The bot clock uses the most runner time and produces nothing
findings.one: bot-chat-poll uses 34% of runner time and 47% of its runs are cancelled. The repo is public, so this is noise, not cost.
ev: bot-chat-poll: 8,669 runs. marjorie-status: 1,577 runs, 1,211 of them skipped.
It exists because GitHub cron delivers only 2 to 22% of hourly-or-faster schedules.
Actions minutes are not billed on a public repo and are separate from Claude plan usage, so this does not cause the weekly-limit problem.
findings.fix: Move the clock to the Hermes doorbell and drop marjorie-status to a real schedule. Flow: Clock. Goal: none directly.

findings.title: We count lines, not content, and none of the community outcomes
findings.one: No item counts, per-lane yield, Reddit scores, replies or news timestamps exist.
ev: The dashboard measures PR lines added, which mixes new items, edits and generated files.
Social metrics stop at Oct 4. Nothing links a shipped item to how users use it.
findings.fix: Yield records in PR bodies, a news_event table, an engagement_outcome table, and a weekly collector that writes them here. Goals 2, 5, 8, 9.

fixes: Give Vault Run its own credential or reserved budget, and alert on "weekly limit" by name. Biggest effect, one workflow edit.
Fix the four failing feeders: appearance-discovery, merch-awin-sync, merch-official-sync, tree-weekly-plan. Pull logs, fix the top cause each.
Fix the draft-happy-path test so social state PRs stop failing, then close the 154 stuck PRs.
Split Vault Run into one job per lane and record items added per lane in the PR body.
Retire the bot-chat-poll clock in favor of the Hermes doorbell and cut marjorie-status runs.
Add item-level yield and app engagement to this dashboard so content quality can be judged, not only volume.
gaps: Items added, edited or removed per lane. Only added lines are counted today.
Why 28 workflows have no metrics. Some are reusable workflows that other jobs call, and some had no runs in the window.
Failure causes for appearance-discovery, merch-awin-sync, news-worker, auto-merge-keepup and Parity (DOM visual).
Billed Actions minutes and the Claude plan usage per routine. Only wall-clock minutes are available.
Whether Hermes-side Tree and Marjorie are running, and what they posted this week.
Reader-side value: opens, saves or shares per piece of content.

annotations.text: Baseline captured. Dashboard built from 173 inventoried automations, 31,076 workflow runs and 1,078 PRs over 30 days.

roadmap.t: Fix the dashboard readme and add 7-day reliability
roadmap.d: Remove the mention of a workflow that does not exist, relabel runner time as not billed, and show 7-day next to 30-day reliability.
roadmap.v: Open the page; Overview text matches the repo and shows two reliability windows.

roadmap.t: Named weekly-limit alert and pause switch
roadmap.d: Detect "hit your weekly limit" in the routine template, open one alert with the reset time, and skip non-content routines until then.
roadmap.v: A forced-limit dry run opens exactly one claude-weekly-limit alert issue.

roadmap.t: Choose the budget model for content routines
roadmap.d: Metered API key for content producers, a second plan seat, or cuts only. This decides whether daily breaking and voice passes are affordable.
roadmap.v: Decision recorded in docs/decisions.md.

roadmap.t: Split Vault Run into one job per lane with yield records
roadmap.d: Each lane runs as its own job and writes items added, edited and skipped into the PR body.
roadmap.v: The next vault/ PR body contains a yield block that parses.

roadmap.t: Media-completeness CI gate
roadmap.d: check-media.mjs fails any new moment without a photo, video or social post unless it has a named exception. Existing offenders sit on a list that can only shrink.
roadmap.v: A test PR adding a photoless moment goes red; main stays green.

roadmap.t: Fix the social state test and clear the 154 stuck PRs
roadmap.d: Make draft-happy-path.test.ts use fixture state, batch the ledger fold-back to daily, then close the stuck PRs.
roadmap.v: gh pr list shows fewer than 10 open automerge:content PRs.

roadmap.t: Confirm the residential relay and flip the theory crawl
roadmap.d: Confirm HOME_RELAY_URL runs on the Hermes side, and set COMMUNITY_CRAWL_ENABLED=true with a budget of 20.
roadmap.v: live_theory rows with origin=fan appear within a day.

roadmap.t: Outcomes reader for upvotes and replies
roadmap.d: Daily job reads the brand account's public comment feed through the relay and records score and replies at 1 hour, 24 hours and 7 days. Adds Page reply counts.
roadmap.v: engagement_outcome has rows with scores for last week's posted comments.

roadmap.t: Breaking lane with a written definition of critical
roadmap.d: Zero-LLM keyword gate, Sonnet classifier, two-outlet or official-source rule in code, live gate, live card, and five timestamps per story. The owner approves the definition once.
roadmap.v: Replaying last month's confirmed big stories as fixtures, each reaches the live feed inside the 60-minute budget in a dry run.

roadmap.t: Push and social for confirmed critical stories
roadmap.d: Wire the critical-story event into the notification dispatcher (the governor stays in charge) and the next poster slot. Decide whether Tree approves automatically.
roadmap.v: A staging device gets one push for a test critical story.

roadmap.t: Weekly news recall audit
roadmap.d: Diff our stories against Google News, top fan posts and official channels. Misses become intake issues.
roadmap.v: First weekly row has events, hits within 48 hours and a list of misses.

roadmap.t: Widen theory sources and lower the promotion bar
roadmap.d: Add the Facebook export, a Reddit theories sub and mainstream roundups. Promote at 2 mentions with a heat score. Record the change in decisions.
roadmap.v: Live fan theories grow week over week toward 50 a week.

roadmap.t: Voice guide, exemplars and a critic pass
roadmap.d: Joey picks about 40 exemplar items with a star reaction in Discord (20 minutes). A separate critic scores new items and a weekly sample of 20.
roadmap.v: voice.json reports a weekly mean and PR bodies carry scores.

roadmap.t: Feed Tree what just shipped
roadmap.d: Add a weekly list of newly shipped moments with media to the social calendar and prefer same-day event drafts about items already live.
roadmap.v: Calendar PRs cite moment IDs; the share of posts citing new content is reported.

roadmap.t: Model and cadence cuts for non-content routines
roadmap.d: Chat and ask-response routines to Sonnet, Marjorie ops to every 3 hours, Tree daily draft to Sonnet with an Opus critic only on breaking.
roadmap.v: Weekly turn ledger drops and no routine hits its turn limit.

roadmap.t: Set the affiliate IDs and approve the weekly matcher spend
roadmap.d: Owner sets the Awin and Amazon tags in Vercel and approves a weekly cap. A disclosure line ships with the first affiliate link.
roadmap.v: A live product page shows a tagged link and a disclosure.

roadmap.t: Photo-to-merch writer and fan merch curation lanes
roadmap.d: A Vault lane that writes matched products onto moments (capped at 3 looks) and a curation lane for fan-made items (capped at 5 a week).
roadmap.v: At least 3 products with a moment and an affiliate link merge in one week.

roadmap.t: Facebook group reply counts via the owner's export
roadmap.d: Extend the weekly export to read reply and reaction counts on the owner's own comments. Read-only, owner-run.
roadmap.v: Outcome rows exist for Facebook comments.

roadmap.t: Move the dashboard into the repo with a weekly collector
roadmap.d: A workflow writes news, community, merch, budget and voice numbers to committed JSON that this page reads, so no Claude session is needed to update it.
roadmap.v: Monday collector run commits fresh JSON and the page shows it.

roadmap.t: Retire the bot-clock noise
roadmap.d: Move marjorie-status to the clock table only and drop its cron; move the clock to the Hermes doorbell.
roadmap.v: Cancelled and skipped runs fall below 10%.

decisions.q: How should content routines be funded?
decisions.why: Metered API key for content only (recommended), a second plan seat, or cuts alone. This decides whether daily breaking and voice passes can run.

decisions.q: May confirmed critical stories post and push without your tap?
decisions.why: Tree can now approve his own IG and X drafts; push stays under the governor. A wrong critical push is the biggest brand risk.

decisions.q: Will the residential relay (HOME_RELAY_URL) run on the Hermes side?
decisions.why: Without it there is no upvote measurement and no theory crawl, because Reddit blocks GitHub IPs.

decisions.q: Set the affiliate IDs now and approve a weekly spend cap for the matcher?
decisions.why: Goal 11 cannot start until tags are set; counsel cleared the layer on Aug 30.

decisions.q: Will you post about 3 comments a day from the brand account, and may the Facebook export read your own activity log for reply counts?
decisions.why: Comments stay human by design, so volume and measurement both depend on you.

avoid: Do not automate Reddit posting, voting or DMs, and never request a Reddit API key.
Do not build a Facebook group crawler. It was ruled out on Aug 11.
Do not let the breaking lane skip the notification governor or the privacy redlines.
Do not rehost full videos or add AI-generated images; use official frames only and honor takedowns.
Do not turn on affiliate links without a visible disclosure.
Do not add new LLM routines before the content pool is separated from chat and ops.
Do not widen the theory bar to private-life speculation. The database is about Easter eggs.
